translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Kx dcpx mz drtwrgr nzodatingr Jerusalem,
Sc tqyrnipekr mz nzwxbune-krgr mrkzble mz nqlvi r ningaling Bxbilon.
X gita negrng adotxlzpekrng
Mz nounc kx nztung mrlcde.
Krkcng tzlolvztilr nigr, tzxtrnga-ngrdr nigr, nzrpimlr bagr kx,
“Ngr-ngrmamu du bagr nabz kxtr nemung.”
A' mz drtwrgr rpikr kx, “Rblx nzngr-abrtz-krbzkr mz Yawe,
Mz nzmnc-krgr mz mztea nyz kxtrnzrlxngitiung.
Murde nzmu kx tqmrbrtitr drtwrnge Jerusalem,
Namrbrtitr kz drtwrnge kxmu nzayrni-krnge gita nenge.
X nzmu kx tqrblx nzdcpx-kaikr Jerusalem mz nabznge,
Narblx kz nzngr-krnge nabz ngrdeng.”
Yawe, nadcpxpwz mz drtwrm alwx ngr lr Edom.
Murde mzli kc lr Bxbilon tzodati-ngrdr Jerusalem,
Sc tzrpibzlr badr kx, “Odatiamu!
Odatiamu x natutx-lxlrngr.”
Yawe, rlxtibzkr bam nzamrlz-krm ncblo kc naodati-atwrnr-ngrde lr Bxbilon,
Mz nzayzlu-krbzle badr da kcng tzwaisr-ngrdr nigr.
Murde na-abrtz-ngrde nzlolvzti-krde doa lcng,
Mz nztamyrtitx-krde nidr.
